study.question: Does the click-AUC advantage of combined buy-context source gradients arise from direction within each field, magnitude allocation across fields, or their interaction?
study.hypothesis: In r0073 product-only context VJPs restored to the total summed norm still trail the combined route (0.6683192162 versus 0.6685318110). This leaves changed field allocation confounded with within-field direction. Preserving the summed per-field magnitudes while using product directions should recover more of the combined-route click AUC than preserving summed directions with product magnitude allocation if field allocation is the main explanation. These are conditional attribution interventions, not an established performance improvement.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local source; split its total-vector direction into field directions and field norm allocation. Both corner controls preserve the old exact upstream formulas.

PCGrad sections 2.1-2.3 change conflicting task parameter gradients by projection. This study exchanges within-field directions and field magnitudes between two paths of one buy loss at the context embedding output; no task conflict projection, extra task backward or optimizer modification. No priority claim.

GradNorm section 3 learns loss weights from task gradient norms and relative training rates. Here loss weights remain one and fixed; only the buy-context VJP has a stateless per-example factorial intervention, without rate targets or learned balancing weights.

DIN archived primary text lines 52-83 motivates target-dependent local activation, inherited here through the frozen adapted model; the field-VJP factorial is a local training diagnostic, not an exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark implementation lines 25-86 contains categorical/task hubs and tokenization. Those architectural changes are not implemented here. Original INFNet paper remains provenance-only; no originality claim against it.

inherited_components: Complete r0073 standalone source, masked 10-block history compression and folded normalization support
Task-specific residual bank, match/order summaries and block-local context-history product
Existing four task towers, feature embeddings, loss and all gradient-ownership boundaries
Two-output context split and the first-order restored buy summary surrogate
study.proposed_difference: Write N_f=(r+p)_f and P_f=p_f for each context field f in FeatureMap order, width embedding_dim=16. Direction factor selects unit(N_f) or unit(P_f). Allocation factor selects ||N_f|| or ||P_f||*||N||/||P||. Cross these two factors into four full-model variants. Corner N/N returns N directly; P/P uses the old whole-vector normalized product formula directly. New P/N and N/P exchange only field directions versus magnitudes. Norms and units use scaled FP32 reductions with explicit zero cases. Private parameter derivatives are not changed at common state; inference bypasses the split. No new parameters, buffers, RNG, current-label routing or input information.
predictions: The sum_sum_bridge should reproduce g0-r0073-both_sum_bridge at common state and the product_product_bridge should reproduce g0-r0073-product_sum_norm; systematic disagreement invalidates attribution.

Allocation-dominant prediction: AUC(product_direction_sum_fields)-AUC(product_product_bridge)>0 and AUC(sum_sum_bridge)-AUC(sum_direction_product_fields)>0, with smaller within-field-direction contrasts.
Direction-dominant alternative reverses the relative sizes of those factor contrasts; report all four contrasts and the interaction A_PP-A_PS-A_SP+A_SS.

All cells should have identical expected parameter counts and common-state predictions; backward runtime may increase and must be measured. Global per-example buy-context norms should equal ||N|| outside rounding and declared degeneracies.
falsifiers: If preserving summed field allocation fails to recover click AUC from the product-only corner while summed within-field directions recover it, reject the allocation-dominant explanation for this implementation.
If neither hybrid approaches the sum_sum control, treat coupled direction/allocation or trajectory effects as unresolved; no isolated-factor mechanism is established.
If common-state forward/private-gradient, ownership, bridge, finite-gradient or field-boundary checks fail, the implementation is inadmissible; do not interpret any score as counterevidence.
If any selected improvement disappears in paired repetitions or has unacceptable measured cost, do not select it as a supported efficiency/performance gain.
alternative_explanations: Per-example embedding-output norms do not match accumulated repeated-ID sparse gradients or Adagrad steps.
Shared context gradients also contain click/cart/fav contributions, so final context parameter norms are not matched.
Divergent trajectories can alter dense global clipping and all later private gradients.
A zero chosen field direction falls back to the other direction; such fields cannot identify direction.
One frozen seed is preliminary; deterministic bridge replay is not independent replication.
Sparse identity field updates may dominate allocation differences; this experiment does not identify which field is causal.
Dense clipping and one-pass optimizer-path effects can generate changes without useful semantic complementarity.
Buy summary direction incumbent exceeds the native bridge by only 0.0000049430 AUC; that tiny single-seed difference is not mechanism evidence.

host_validation_plan: Use only registered host propose consumer with proposal.json and the four source files. The coding workspace has no training interface; no install or local training command is supplied.

Before scoring, verify existing pinned dataset digests, feature-map/loader/visibility receipts, frozen protocol hash and current resource ledger. No raw data has been independently inspected here. Current runtime previous_runtime_error is null.

Verify all context fields are uniform embedding_dim=16 outputs in self.user_fields order and context.shape[-1]==len(self.user_fields)*16. Heterogeneous widths are inadmissible for this implementation, not silently regrouped.

Confirm strict common-state parameter and buffer key compatibility, identical construction RNG and counts 32192421 total /31793216 embedding /399205 dense. Check all four train/eval forward probabilities and post-forward buffers at common state are identical, in FP32 and BF16, including nonzero output-projection weights (zero initialization otherwise hides the change).

At fixed state compare sum_sum upstream context gradient to r0073 both source and product_product gradient to r0073 product_sum_norm source. FP32 atol1e-6 rtol1e-5 and BF16 atol1e-3 rtol1e-2 are numerical comparison tolerances, not causal validation; systematic drift blocks attribution. Native corner must match ordinary split autograd.

Test the VJP directly with independent synthetic route gradients, random vectors, unequal field norms, repeated identical embedding IDs, all-zero routes, zero total, one zero field, exact within-field cancellation, tiny and large finite FP32 values and BF16 inputs. Verify output norm and selected per-field norm identities where nondegenerate, and specified fallbacks elsewhere. This surrogate intentionally fails a forward finite-difference gradient check; require the declared algebra instead. No higher-order derivative support is claimed.

At common state differentiate each task loss separately: only buy-to-context embedding-output derivative may differ. Every buy private residual/query/history/output/tower parameter derivative remains equal before global clipping. Click/cart/fav input/parameter derivatives agree. Buy item/action inputs and scorer parameters remain gradient blocked; auxiliary direct tower context remains blocked. Do not mistake later trajectory differences for a common-state violation.

Check all four labels/masks under reordered task schema and state, finite [B,1] probabilities, default sum-four-BCE backward, empty/single/full/noncontiguous history masks, invalid masked-history perturbations, exclusion of target action, device/checkpoint round trips and eval split bypass.

Report full validation click and all four task AUC/logloss, auxiliary mean separately, positive/negative/sample counts, allocated GPU/train/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, parameter counts, model-only whole-batch p50/p95 latency and throughput at fixed batch8192. Predeclared history bins are empty,1..16,17..64,>64; available other slices exploratory, unavailable time/frequency data not fabricated.

Bridge replay is an execution control, not a repeated seed. Analyze the two paired direction contrasts, two paired allocation contrasts and factorial interaction without post-hoc selection of the favorable contrast. Single-seed conclusions remain provisional; paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host exposes authorized user clusters, otherwise mark unavailable.

Keep all receipts including failed checks and preserve every old record. No writable agent-memory endpoint is exposed: append these prospective observations/provenance through host proposal/receipt ingestion; do not edit evidence.jsonl, imported sources or human knowledge. Freeze the suite before any later separately authorized withheld assessment.
